meta.title: Preview, check, look and handoff tools (other modes)
meta.description: Lets Standard, Creator and other modes use preview_page (open pages in the Design Studio sidebar), check_design (measure design problems at real sizes), look_design (real-size screenshots for the model), extract_design_system (pull a brand design system from a site or project), and handoff_design / compare_design (build the design as real code and pixel-compare it with the design). The Design mode has its own copy and ignores this switch.
